pages.text: All your towns form one $(l)kingdom$() with exactly one $(l)capital$(), at first your first town. $(l)Make capital$() on the Overview moves it (once a day, never during a raid).$(br2)Only the capital can reach Capital rank. There, with Royal Charter, builders raise a $(l)41 × 41 Capital Castle$() around the town centre, keeping the courtyard and central buildings.
